item.title: Holiday deliveries coming to some homes by air, without the ‘ho ho ho’
item.description: They will not be dropping packages down your chimney, but unmanned air couriers will be able to deliver to your lawn in time for Christmas, if you live near one of six Walmart Supercenters in the suburbs that ring Atlanta. item.title: Museum to host Pearl Harbor Remembrance Day event on Dec. 7
